doc_verification.detail: POST /cluster/recover is documented. The endpoint returns 500 'Service internal error: Qdrant is running in standalone mode' when called in standalone deployment. HTTP semantics suggest client misuse (calling cluster operation in standalone mode) should return 4xx, not 5xx.

execution_evidence.log_pattern: c3: POST /cluster/recover in standalone mode → http=500, error='Service internal error: Qdrant is running in standalone mode'
secondary_observations: c2: GET /cluster in standalone mode → http=200

http_semantics.client_error_returned_as: HTTP 5xx (server error code for client misuse)
http_semantics.note: Client misuse (calling cluster operation in standalone mode) returns 500 instead of 4xx. HTTP semantics: 5xx indicates server fault, 4xx indicates client error. This is a server error code misuse.

contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: N/A - This is a semantic/HTTP specification issue, not a contract constraint violation

chain_links: script:Recover operation called in standalone mode
log:500 returned instead of 4xx for client misuse
chain_trace.break_detail: No contract constraint violated. Issue is HTTP semantics: server returns 500 for client-side misuse (calling cluster operation in standalone mode). RFC 9110 Section 15: 5xx codes indicate server failure, 4xx indicate client error. This is misclassification of error type.

grep_queries: Qdrant is running in standalone mode
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: recover_current_peer function calls dispatcher.toc().request_snapshot() without checking consensus_state(). When consensus is None (standalone mode), operations fail. The error is generated via StorageError::service_error() which maps to HTTP 500. No validation logic returns 4xx for standalone cluster operations.

mundane_explanation.surviving: Server returns 500 for client misuse (calling cluster operation in standalone mode). RFC 9110 classifies 5xx as server fault, 4xx as client error. This is HTTP semantic violation, not by-design behavior. Historical issue qdrant#9421 documents same phenomenon.
